title: Localized Mayer-Vietoris triangle presentation
statement: Let $Y$ be a scheme in universe $u$, let $A,B$ be opens with $A\cup B=Y$, and fix derived categories of module sheaves on $Y$ and its localized open sites in morphism universe $w$ [def-pc-derived-category]. For each perfect quasi-coherent derived object $E$ [def-pc-perfect-complex], there is an ambient distinguished triangle $T$ whose first object is isomorphic to $E$, whose second object satisfies $M_{A,B}$, and whose third object satisfies $N_{A,B}$ [def-perfect-gluing-endpoint-properties]. No quasi-coherence of these endpoint objects is required.

source.place: Tag 08BV, lemma-exact-sequence-j-star; Step 2 of lem-pc-perfect-complexes-compact-set, using Tag 08DR

proof.text: Transport the local derived-category structures to open subschemes using the explicit abelian over-site equivalences. Construct a standard derived category on each open scheme, identify it with the given localized derived category using Equivalence.mapDerivedCategory, and shrink its morphisms to w via hasLocalizationOfLocallySmall.
Represent E by Q.objPreimage and take the functorial K-injective resolution I with injective terms. Q of its quasi-isomorphism gives an isomorphism QI to E.

Derive the restriction/direct-image adjunctions and apply the existing K-injective Mayer-Vietoris short-exact presentation to get complexes L,M, a short exact sequence I to L to M, and comparison isomorphisms with the direct-image endpoints.

The private comparison helper derives the localized restriction/right-adjoint adjunction. Compose the scheme adjunction with the inverse of the derived over-site equivalence. mapDerivedCategoryCompIso and the equivalence unit identify its left adjoint with localized restriction. rightAdjointUniq identifies the right adjoints, yielding a natural isomorphism between each localized localTerm and scheme restriction followed by derived direct image.

Take the actual triangleOfSES hS, distinguished by triangleOfSES_distinguished. Its first term is QI, isomorphic to E. Compose biprod.mapIso of the localized comparison components with eL inverse, and the overlap comparison with eM inverse. The endpoint properties are witnessed by E with its supplied perfectness proof.

lean.statement: theorem perfectGluing_triangle_presentation (Y : Scheme.{u}) (A B : Y.Opens) (hcover : A ⊔ B = ⊤) [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))] [∀ W : Y.Opens, HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace).over W))] (E : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y) (hE : IsPerfect Y E.obj) : ∃ T : Triangle (schemeDerivedCategory Y), T ∈ distTriang (schemeDerivedCategory Y) ∧ perfectGluingMiddleProperty Y A B T.obj₂ ∧ perfectGluingOverlapProperty Y A B T.obj₃ ∧ Nonempty (T.obj₁ ≅ E.obj)
